description: Verified targetable claims extracted from the manuscripts of test-set entries, keyed by BioModels accession. Each entry drives certify_model to produce a certificate in the blind run. A claim's reference value is a number the paper itself prints (cited in source_location), not one from re-running the model here. It may be a value the paper measured or one the paper's own model produced — the source_location says which, and the two differ: for BIOMD0000001028 the measured plasma Cmax values are 5.7 and 12.9 nmol/mL and the simulated ones 6.1 and 11.2, and it is the simulated ones a reproduction targets. datasets/manuscripts/ quotes the cited rows so the values can be checked against the paper offline. Entries are added only after a claim has been extracted and its reproduction verified by hand; the rest of the test set is honestly blocked until then. Each claim also states the unit the paper prints it in (reported_units), which is checked against the unit the model reads that output in: a number compared against a model output in another unit is a verdict about arithmetic, and nothing downstream can see it.
